rules.title: ReactDOM.render has been removed in React 19
rules.description: ReactDOM.render has been removed in React 19. Applications must migrate to createRoot from 'react-dom/client'.

rules.title: ReactDOM.unmountComponentAtNode has been removed in React 19
rules.description: ReactDOM.unmountComponentAtNode has been removed in React 19. Use root.unmount() on the root created by createRoot.

remediation.summary: Call root.unmount() on the instance returned by createRoot instead of ReactDOM.unmountComponentAtNode.

rules.title: ReactDOM.findDOMNode has been removed in React 19
rules.description: ReactDOM.findDOMNode has been removed in React 19. Pass a ref directly to the underlying DOM node.

remediation.summary: Pass a DOM ref directly to the native element instead of calling ReactDOM.findDOMNode.

rules.title: React.PropTypes has been removed from the core react package in React 19
rules.description: Accessing PropTypes directly on React (React.PropTypes) has been removed. Use TypeScript or import PropTypes from the standalone 'prop-types' package.

remediation.summary: Import PropTypes from 'prop-types' or migrate components to TypeScript interfaces.
remediation.exampleAfter:
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
MyComponent.propTypes = { name: PropTypes.string };

rules.title: Legacy string refs have been removed in React 19
rules.description: String refs (e.g. <input ref='myInput' /> and this.refs.myInput) are removed in React 19. Use callback refs or useRef / createRef.

remediation.summary: Replace string refs with useRef() hooks or callback refs.

rules.title: Legacy lifecycle methods (componentWillMount, componentWillReceiveProps, componentWillUpdate) removed
rules.description: Legacy class lifecycle methods without UNSAFE_ prefix have been removed in React 19. Migrate to componentDidMount / componentDidUpdate or React Hooks.

remediation.summary: Migrate legacy lifecycles to componentDidMount, componentDidUpdate, or convert class to a function component with useEffect.

rules.title: useFormState replaced by useActionState in React 19
rules.description: In React 19, useFormState from 'react-dom' is deprecated in favor of useActionState from 'react'.

remediation.summary: Replace useFormState from 'react-dom' with useActionState imported from 'react'.

rules.title: act from 'react-dom/test-utils' moved to 'react' in React 19
rules.description: react-dom/test-utils has been deprecated and act has moved directly into the core 'react' package.
